title: Community Store for Concrete CMS before 2.8.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows…
description: Community Store for Concrete CMS versions prior to 2.8.0 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts via the order email field in the order management page. When a store manager views the affected order, the injected script executes in their session, potentially compromising confidentiality and integrity.
